intro: The Gentlemen, Interlock, and Kyber were the most active ransomware threat actors across 43 articles published between April 12 and May 1, 2026. The archive covers 34 high-severity incidents and four critical events, with CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8) appearing as the top vulnerabilities. Affected sectors include healthcare, manufacturing, technology, and critical infrastructure, with reports spanning the United States, Europe, North America, and Turkey.
